title: [v0.4.29] Audit: verify host portability and architecture
author: mcpdev80
body:
Parent: #876 · Final acceptance: #174 · Related: #805, #175, #603, #777

## Goal

Audit the actual v0.4.29 host-platform implementations before final contract acceptance in #174/v0.4.31. Passing this audit alone does not implement a platform or promote its support level.

#876 is the authoritative delivery scope: Linux preservation; genuine WSL2 Dev Local/Remote; macOS arm64 Dev Local with Docker Desktop and Podman Machine. Automatic macOS Keychain trust and Dev Remote are explicitly deferred to #886; signing/notarization to #885. Historical future-only implementation non-goals and the superseded v0.4.25 assignment are removed.

## Audit boundaries

Portable Application Intent, Target/Access, Runtime/Capability Provider and lifecycle/result semantics stay platform-neutral. Host/runtime mechanisms must remain behind their actual implementation boundaries.

Review at least resource/memory/VM limits, state/config/filesystem ownership, trust/certificates, secure ephemeral material, PTY/terminal, runtime/socket discovery, process/service managers, networking/localhost/browser routes, architecture compatibility and install/update artifact selection.

Linux-specific /proc, cgroups, systemd/systemctl, trust-store paths, socket paths and ioctl mechanisms must not become required portable/application semantics. WSL2 remains Linux execution, distinct from native Windows. Darwin containers execute in a Linux runtime VM; Quadlet/systemd are Podman implementation details.

## D1–D5 review

- **D1:** verify selected endpoint → owned running VM provenance, privilege/isolation distinction, safe file-sharing and socket boundaries. Context names, OS and rootful status alone are not proof. No implicit privileged-host fallback.
- **D2:** verify source/environment binding, freshness, effective limits and measured/estimated/unknown evidence. Physical RAM, MemTotal/MemFree and total minus container stats alone cannot establish SAFE. Plan/preflight do not start probes or mutate.
- **D3:** provider-internal Podman Machine executor preserves Linux Quadlet semantics and ownership; no generic remote-exec/MCP escape.
- **D4:** #823/#884 maintain four distinct lanes with exact source/runtime/runner evidence. Build/native conformance cannot replace genuine Mac/WSL2 container journeys.
- **D5:** platform artifact/update selection preserves portable intent. Ad-hoc signing is distinct from Developer ID/notarization; clean-Mac installer/browser behavior is honestly qualified and documented.

D1/D2 must have explicit contract review recorded in the pinned spec before dependent implementation; no silent redefinition of #872 semantics.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Every audited platform-specific call site belongs to an explicit host/runtime/Target boundary.
- [ ] Resource/trust/path/terminal result semantics remain portable; vendor mechanisms stay internal.
- [ ] D1/D2/D3 implementation and negative tests match the reviewed contract.
- [ ] Runtime/VM available capacity, overhead and limits are distinguished from physical-host totals and partial estimates.
- [ ] WSL2/native Windows and Darwin host/Linux runtime VM remain distinct.
- [ ] amd64/arm64 differences are artifact/runtime compatibility, not application intent.
- [ ] Linux regression, genuine WSL2 and both macOS arm64 engines have required exact-source evidence and owned cleanup.
- [ ] #805 EN/DE matrix matches actual per-combination evidence; no upgrade from audit/build success alone.
- [ ] #885/#886 deferred capabilities remain explicitly unclaimed in v0.4.29.
- [ ] Any discovered frozen Linux-only public semantic is fixed or explicitly reviewed before #174 closes.
